description: Symone, a spirited and vibrant plus-size woman in her 30s, finds herself navigating the unpredictable world of modern dating while grappling with the emotional aftermath of her one-night stand with Andre, her high school sweetheart.

description: Bride to be, Nahdulay Ncala's world is turned upside down as she finds herself in the middle of a dangerous quest for a royal jewel. Traveling from Africa to America, Nahdulay connects with an unsuspecting driver who helps her uncover the truth.

title: Breaking Free
description: When his wife is murdered in their own home, Joe, an undercover cop, spirals out of control with alcohol and substance abuse.

title: Rhythm and Revenge
description: After losing her parents, Journi, a talented but troubled teenager, moves in with her aunt and cousin for a fresh start. As she navigates the pressures of competitive dance, strange accidents begin to occur around her.

title: How Did We Get Here
description: Four struggling couples attend a wellness retreat led by Dr. Sellers. Melonie and Derrick struggle with issues of infidelity.

title: The Jealous Son
description: Seduced by her boyfriend's charming son, a woman soon finds herself trapped in a dangerous obsession that will push her to her limits.

title: But I'm Married
description: Kimora and Jamal's seemingly perfect marriage falters. Seeking to reignite passion, Kimora explores unconventional options, including a third person. This decision unleashes a web of lies and betrayal, forcing Kimora to confront hidden desires.

title: Redemption
description: Lost and grieving, Chris seeks solace in the wrong crowd. A chance encounter with the enigmatic Patrick leads him down a dangerous path, forcing him to confront his own morality and the consequences of his choices.

title: Why Not You
description: Mario, a young dancer living in his small village, has to face the loss of his beloved friend Lenz, a victim of an attack in a gay club.

title: The New Girl
description: When her sister Monica suddenly disappears under suspicious circumstances, Malorie becomes convinced that Monica's seemingly perfect husband is hiding something sinister.

title: Deceptive Touch
description: Cam believes she's finally found "The One" in her charismatic boyfriend Ant. Everything seems perfect until a shocking discovery about Ant's past threatens to unravel their idyllic life.

title: Shotlanta
description: Mozzy, driven by a desire to lift his family out of poverty in Jamaica, immigrates to Atlanta. Determined to achieve wealth and security for his mother and sister, his ruthless pursuit of success puts him on a dangerous path.

title: Kitty Hallow Killer
description: Mason and Jessica get into a horrible car accident on their wedding day, Jessica wakes up with no memory of her life or even her husband. As her memories start to come back in pieces, she is afraid that her husband could be a known serial killer.

title: Cougar
description: An older woman, Christine moves in next door to a mother and her son. Christine then develops a connection with Brandon, involving a deadly game of lies, sex, and deceit.

title: The Good Sister
description: Raven moves in with her sister Devin and her husband in Atlanta, where she begins to dig her claws into Devin's life and home, and seducing her husband. Devin must make a choice that could be deadly to save her own life and happiness.

title: The Drive
description: A doctor is driving home from a conference when he learns his daughter has been kidnapped and the betrayal comes from those closest to him. The certainty that someone within his trusted circle is responsible turns the journey into a spiral of shock.

description: Corey Spencer, the innovator behind the successful ATLUV dating app, navigates a complex personal life. Despite his app's mission, he struggles with love, further complicated by a child support order.

title: The Only Child

description: Bright and gifted Jessica takes on a side hustle tutoring popular football star, Ryan. After the football team wins the championship game, Ryan decides to throw an after party at his house. When Ryan is found dead, multiple people are suspects.

title: Three Secrets
description: A couple tries to bring life back into their marriage by bringing in another woman, but the relationship is built on lies.

title: The Break of Dawn
description: College student Dawn Monea tried to find love through online dating, but soon finds out the man she is dating is not who he says he is.

title: The New Girl
description: When her sister Monica suddenly disappears under suspicious circumstances, Malorie becomes convinced that Monica's seemingly perfect husband is hiding something sinister.

description: Diamond White, a college graduate drowning in debt and raising his younger sister, turns to dancing for survival; after moving to Texas, he joins Midnight, an underground male club and quickly rises to the top.

description: A struggling single mother finds love again with her son's track coach, but her seemingly fresh start is tested by his deeply racist father.

title: Tainted Waters
description: An unknowingly selfish mechanic, unable to save his failing business, agrees to take part in a four-man robbery. Now hiding out from the cops, he must survive the night in a room of people where he's not the most selfish.

title: Busted and Disgusted
description: Two sisters, Faith and Promise, overcome their difficult childhood following the death of their mother to cancer. Faith has it all. Promise feels threatened by her older sister's success and seeks to claim her happiness for herself.

description: Florence is a housewife who yearns for something new and exciting in her love life. Things turn deadly real quick when she doesn't get what she wants.

title: Women of the Jury
description: A man is on trial accused of the murder of two young Black men, and 12 women are called to serve on the jury. After deliberation, one juror is convinced the man is not guilty, while the majority claims he is guilty.

title: American Girl
description: A determined 19-year-old girl escapes her toxic stepfather in rural Georgia, embarking on a challenging journey to survival on the streets of Atlanta.

title: A Matter of Heart
description: Balen, a successful family man, risks everything for a reckless affair with Latricia that devastates his family. His devoted wife, Krista, will soon face a painful truth that shows her sacrifices may have been in vain.

title: Trouble
description: As Draven faces financial ruin and a serious illness, her marriage to Adam frays. She reconnects with Cecelius, a wealthy ex, finding comfort in his stability. But as their romance blossoms, Adam's jealousy spirals into something dangerous.

title: His Masterpiece
description: Victoria and Richard are divorced spouses that operate an art gallery together. After meeting young artist Daniel at a community event, they decide to collaborate with him on the exhibit to generate income for their tax obligations.

title: The One That Got Away
description: Blake is engaged to Jessica, who then becomes ensnared in a dangerous game of deception and revenge by his vengeful ex, London. As their past resurfaces, he is forced to confront hidden secrets and navigate London's sinister manipulations.

title: Kinfolk
description: Eboni is a hair stylist dreaming of owning a successful salon in her hometown, with the support of her half-siblings Beau and Hillary. Things get complicated when their father attempts to reconcile for the past.

title: A Secret Lie in Love
description: Clarice and Chase Scott have the perfect suburban life on the outside. But, their marriage that was built on passion, has become a battlefield of deceit, infidelity and betrayal. Clarice finds solace in the arms of another man.

title: Hated by Many, Loved by None
description: After a violent robbery and a shocking betrayal from her incarcerated husband, Jahzara is forced to fend for herself in a world she was never meant to lead. With her closest friends, she steps into the drug game, determined to rebuild her life.

title: Only 48
description: When Tracy Harris is abducted and held for ransom, her father Keith has only 48 hours to deliver $500,000. Forced back into the criminal world he tried to escape, Keith faces dangerous alliances and hidden truths in order to save his daughter.
